how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:warlock-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1470:details:0: Greetings, child. I can see that you are still young in the ways of the warlock, power still eluding your grasp. I can sense your eagerness to learn.
rows.quest:1470:details:2: BThere is no strength in ignorance. Knowledge is our greatest power. Through its application, we can control the chaotic magics and beings of the void, bending them to our will.
rows.quest:1470:details:3: BI will show you how to bind a servant to your will, but first you must bring me three skulls of the rattlecage skeletons near the abandoned smithy.
rows.quest:1470:completion:0: Though you are still untested and young in your learning, you have proven that you possess sufficient ability to master the summoning and binding of an imp. Do not be deceived by an imp's size. Though it lacks physical strength, it possesses powers and a cleverness that will serve you well.
rows.quest:1470:completion:1: BAttend me carefully, ⟦1⟧, for I will not repeat this lesson, and I will leave its mastery to you.
rows.quest:1471:obj:0: Using the Runes of Summoning, summon and subdue a voidwalker, then return the Runes of Summoning to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1471:details:0: Surely you have seen the circle of summoning below us? Only there will you be able to draw forth an unbound voidwalker.
rows.quest:1471:details:1: BUsing these runes, you will be able to draw it forth, and then you must dominate it through strength of arms and magic.
rows.quest:1471:details:2: BWhen it is subdued, it will be indentured to you. Come to me then, and I will elucidate the spell of summoning, so that it may serve you to whatever end you wish.
rows.quest:1471:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦2⟧. Now, I will impart to you the spell used for summoning the voidwalker.
rows.quest:1471:completion:1: BThe power that it unleashed upon you is now yours to command. Use it wisely.
rows.quest:1472:obj:0: Speak with Godrick Farsan in the Temple of the Damned.
rows.quest:1472:details:0: A succubus is a devourer of souls, destroyer of hearts, tempter of men. A creature of profound evil and of singular mind.
rows.quest:1472:details:1: BIt cannot be brought into our world without a stimulus.
rows.quest:1472:details:2: BThus we use its own strength against it. With the hearts of good men, pure men, loving men, the succubus will be unable to resist, and will cross into our world. Then you can dominate it, and make it your own.
rows.quest:1472:details:3: BSpeak with my assistant, Godrick Farsan, within the Temple. He will help you find your bait.
rows.quest:1472:completion:0: You were sent by Carendin? ⟦3⟧, then.⟦4⟧⟦5⟧Do not think light of me because my sight is gone. I see things that lie behind now, with clarity I had never known. What I once thought a curse, is now a boon.
rows.quest:1473:obj:0: Recover Egalin's Grimoire and bring it to Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned.
rows.quest:1473:details:0: It seems the consensus that you are ready to learn to summon a voidwalker.
rows.quest:1473:details:1: BA being created of the chaos that lies beyond, if you summon one but cannot control it, you will be torn asunder.
rows.quest:1473:details:2: BThe first voidwalker was summoned by Egalin, and in his grimoire is the process explained.
rows.quest:1473:details:3: BUnfortunately, it was stolen from us by an agent of the ⟦E2⟧ who has it secreted away in his base at a tower to the west. Bring it to me, and I will impart the knowledge to you.
rows.quest:1473:completion:0: Ah, this is excellent. Like as not, Perrine was ignorant to the true power of the musty book he had stolen from us.
rows.quest:1473:completion:1: BIt will not fall out of our hands again. Observe, ⟦6⟧, the structure of the spell, the manner in which your power must be channeled.
rows.quest:1474:obj:0: Using the Pure Hearts, summon and subdue a succubus, then return the Pure Hearts to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1474:details:0: Using these hearts, cast a spell at the summoning circle to open a doorway for the succubus to come through. Your powers are greater now, and you will need all of them to defeat the succubus.
rows.quest:1474:details:1: BBeware its charms, ⟦7⟧, many a strong mind has been bound to its will. When overcome, the succubus will be returned to the void, and I will teach you the spell to summon it forth at your command.
rows.quest:1474:completion:0: Again, you have done well, ⟦8⟧. It has been quite some time since I have seen a young warlock with as much potential as you. Be assured that I will continue to watch your progress, and prepare and assist you in your future trials.
rows.quest:1474:completion:1: BFor now, let me show you the summoning spell for your newly dominated succubus.
rows.quest:1476:obj:0: Bring the hearts of Dalin Forgewright and Comar Villard to Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned.
rows.quest:1476:details:0: Men of honor and goodness? Does such a man exist?
rows.quest:1476:details:1: BIt took much research, but through bits of overheard stories, I managed to find two men that should do.
rows.quest:1476:details:2: BThe first is Dalin Forgewright, who has dedicated himself to the care of the Lordaeron refugees, whom are refused by their kin at the Greymane Wall.
rows.quest:1476:details:3: BThe other is Comar Villard, a man who remains faithful to his lost love, wandering the ⟦E3⟧ for a sign of his wife.
rows.quest:1476:details:4: BDeliver their hearts to Carendin. But first, let me show you your quarry.
rows.quest:1476:completion:0: The heart of a goodly man seems much the same as any, when you see it like this, don't you think?
rows.quest:1476:completion:1: BPerhaps we possess something of a... different... view on the subject. These will do, though. I have no doubt that a succubus would be attracted by their purity.
rows.quest:1478:obj:0: Speak with Carendin Halgar in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1478:details:0: Ah, ⟦9⟧! I just received word from Carendin Halgar that he would like to see you for further training.
rows.quest:1478:details:1: BYou should be proud of yourself, ⟦10⟧. It's not every day that Master Halgar personally sees fit to instruct a young warlock.
rows.quest:1478:details:2: BYou'll be able to find him in the Magic Quarter of the ⟦E1⟧, near the Temple of the Damned.
rows.quest:1478:completion:0: Good, I see Ageron managed to find you, ⟦11⟧. Let us waste little time with small talk and pleasantries and focus on your training. There is still much you have to learn.
rows.quest:1485:obj:0: Bring 6 Vile Familiar Heads to Ruzan.
rows.quest:1485:details:0: Those warlocks who came before us have earned the distrust of the ⟦E4⟧, and while we are tolerated, we are not loved.
rows.quest:1485:details:1: BThis has not brought the warlocks closer together, however, as many choose to live reclusively, dabbling in their magics alone. I will not seek to lead you down one path or the other, but only help you in your maturation.
rows.quest:1485:details:2: BBefore I teach you the art of summoning, bring me six heads of the vile familiars from the cave to the northeast.
rows.quest:1485:completion:0: Throughout your training as a warlock, you will learn to call forth beings of many sorts. Some may not seem it, but all are useful tools.
rows.quest:1485:completion:1: BDo not be fooled by the imp's small size. As you no doubt noticed, it is still a formidable adversary.
rows.quest:1499:details:0: Zureetha has been sending novices like yourself to help cull the numbers of the creatures in the cave near where you fought the vile familiars.
rows.quest:1499:details:1: BI think it would be good for you to gain experience by assisting her. Be sure to tell her that you assisted with the imp problem, she'll probably have a reward for you.
rows.quest:1499:completion:1: BAlthough the vile familiars were merely pets of the darker powers within the Burning Blade, your success against them foretells greater deeds ahead.
rows.quest:1501:obj:0: Retrieve the Tablet of Verga for Gan'rul Bloodeye in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:1501:details:0: So few warlocks remain... We risk much, but the risks are warranted. You must quickly reach maturity in your ability if you are to be of use to the ⟦E4⟧ and to the Warchief.
rows.quest:1501:details:1: BIt is time that you learned a new summoning spell.
rows.quest:1501:details:2: BFirst, you must recover the Tablet of Verga, which was stolen by warlocks of the Burning Blade and is now kept at their lair in Skull Rock to the east of the city. With the tablet, I will show you the runes necessary to summoning a voidwalker.
rows.quest:1501:completion:0: Good. I hope you inflicted some other losses on the Burning Blade when you went to retrieve this.
rows.quest:1501:completion:1: BThey have been a source of great annoyance for the Warchief, and a great blight upon warlocks as a whole.
rows.quest:1504:obj:0: Using the Glyphs of Summoning, summon and subdue a voidwalker, then return the Glyphs of Summoning to Gan'rul Bloodeye in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:1504:details:0: Now, observe the Tablet of Verga, for it contains the glyphs you will need for the summoning. Take them to the circle in Neeru Fireblade's tent on the other side of the cavern. There you will be able to call for the voidwalker.
rows.quest:1504:details:1: BYou must defeat it using whatever physical and magical means you have at your disposal. When this is completed, return to me with the glyphs of summoning and I will demonstrate how you may bind the creature to your will.
rows.quest:1504:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦13⟧. I will show you how to summon the voidwalker similar to the one you just defeated.
rows.quest:1504:completion:1: BYou should know that we have high expectations for you, and you have, so far, matched them.
rows.quest:1504:completion:2: BDo not let it go to your head, however, as the tasks that still lie before you will make this seem as simple as waking in the morning.
rows.quest:1506:details:1: BI hope your schedule isn't busy, because Gan'rul wants to see you right away. You'll find him with the senior warlocks in the Cleft of Shadow.
rows.quest:1506:details:2: BBased on my past dealings with Gan'rul, your summons is either a very good thing or a very bad thing.
rows.quest:1506:completion:0: Good. I was afraid Ophek wouldn't reach you.
rows.quest:1506:completion:1: BIt is time that I further your warlock training. Any business you have currently will have to wait.
rows.quest:1506:completion:2: BI trust there will not be a problem with this?
rows.quest:1507:obj:0: Speak with Cazul in the Cleft of Shadow.
rows.quest:1507:details:0: The time has come for you to learn more of the summoning magics. You will learn to summon a succubus, a creature of incredible mental powers. It can lull those of weak minds into its servitude--but have no fear! I feel certain that you will be equal to the challenge.
rows.quest:1507:details:1: BA succubus can only be summoned when baited with an item that represents great devotion and love. I leave it to you to find such an object.
rows.quest:1507:details:2: BA suggestion? Speak with Cazul... There seems to be little the ancient warlock does not know.
rows.quest:1507:completion:0: Hm... ⟦15⟧. You are still new to your path, but I sense the possibility for greatness in you.
rows.quest:1507:completion:1: BYou were born with gifts, ⟦16⟧. See that they do not go to waste.
rows.quest:1508:details:0: Hmm... But, of course, that is not why you have come to speak with me.
rows.quest:1508:details:1: BIf Gan'rul has sent you to me, it must be that you are to summon a succubus, and need an object to use for enticement.
rows.quest:1508:details:2: BHmm... If you trust a blind man to lead you, ⟦17⟧, then listen. In the bluffs of ⟦E5⟧, west of the wind rider tower, lives Zankaja. She waits for the return of her mate.
rows.quest:1508:completion:0: Have you come with news of Dogran? He was to have returned days ago, and I have heard nothing...
rows.quest:1509:obj:0: Speak with Gazrog at the Crossroads.
rows.quest:1509:details:0: My mate, Dogran, was recently sent to the Crossroads for duty. It was a promotion, and he was very proud.
rows.quest:1509:details:1: BI was sad, of course, but I didn't let him know that. And worried, too. ⟦E6⟧ is a more dangerous place than ⟦E5⟧, and I feared the worst.
rows.quest:1509:details:2: BNow it's been a week after he should have returned, and I have received no word from him...
rows.quest:1509:details:3: BPerhaps you could go to the Crossroads and see if they have any news? He worked with Gazrog, who should still be stationed there.
rows.quest:1509:completion:1: BYeah, I've heard from him, but it's not the sort of news we should let get back to her...
rows.quest:1509:completion:2: BNo, he's not dead. But he is injured and a prisoner of the quilboar.
rows.quest:1510:obj:0: Speak with Ken'zigla at the Malaka'jin.
rows.quest:1510:details:0: He was stationed at Camp Taurajo, where we've been trying to weed out the quilboar. He led a few grunts to one of their camps, where he was hurt bad. The others made it back and tried to rescue him. He was in bad shape, his wounds festered, so they were afraid to move him without patching him up first.
rows.quest:1510:details:1: BThey sent a message here, requesting a healing draught from the trolls at the Malaka'jin at the base of the ⟦E7⟧. We sent someone to get it, but they haven't returned yet.
rows.quest:1510:completion:0: Another ⟦18⟧, eh? I hope you haven't come for the other. He didn't make it. Those goblins did him in good.
rows.quest:1510:completion:1: BHe said he needed a healing draught, but not much else.
rows.quest:1511:obj:0: Bring Ken'zigla's Draught to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.
rows.quest:1511:details:0: I figured there might be another coming to get the draught, so I prepared it anyways.
rows.quest:1511:details:1: BHere you go, ⟦19⟧. Mind you, you should only give half of it to him! That will give him enough strength to move without bleeding himself dry. Wait a night, then give him the other half.
rows.quest:1511:details:2: BAnyways, you'll want to bring this to Logmar at Camp Taurajo. From what the first one told me, he should have an idea where this Dogran is.
rows.quest:1511:completion:0: Well, it's about time! Dogran has been dying out there, waiting for this.
rows.quest:1511:completion:1: BWe need to get this out to him right away, but most of the grunts stationed here are out on a foraging mission.
rows.quest:1512:obj:0: Bring the Dirt-caked Pendant to Gan'rul Bloodeye in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:1512:details:0: Zankaja is young and beautiful. To be chained to an invalid... I will not allow her to suffer that injustice.
rows.quest:1512:details:1: BLeave me, ⟦20⟧. And thank you. I may end my life in glorious battle, instead of a lifeless husk.
rows.quest:1512:details:2: BAnd please, I would ask you not to tell my mate of this... I do not want guilt on her conscience.
rows.quest:1512:completion:0: If you tell me that this will suffice, then I trust you, ⟦21⟧. Allow me to clean it though... Pristine and shining, it may be even more enticing to a succubus.
rows.quest:1513:obj:0: Using Dogran's Pendant, summon and subdue a succubus, then return Dogran's Pendant to Gan'rul Bloodeye in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:1513:details:0: Take this to the summoning circle in Neeru's tent, ⟦22⟧. Summon forth a foul succubus, then show it your mastery. I believe in the strength of your magic. As always, though, be wary, for pride and overconfidence has overcome many a promising warlock.
rows.quest:1513:details:1: BWhen you have defeated it, return the pendant to me so that I might deliver the news to Zankaja.
rows.quest:1513:completion:0: Success! Be sure I expected nothing less from my star pupil.
rows.quest:1513:completion:1: BYou have proven your worth, and gladly will I show you the method of summoning your subdued succubus. Go now, you have much to learn, and when next I see you, I will expect you to have found true mastery over your succubus.
rows.quest:1513:completion:2: BLeave the sorrow of Dogran and Zankaja to those of us who are longer in years, but remember it, and hold it as protection against the wiles of the dark power you have learned to summon today.
rows.quest:1515:obj:0: Bring Ken'zigla's Draught to Dogran in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:1515:details:0: You've made it this far, so if you want to see this through to the end, I won't stop you. I can't spare you any additional manpower though, you'll be on your own.
rows.quest:1515:details:1: BDogran is being held in a quilboar camp to the north of here. Look for a group of two huts. He'll be heavily guarded--that is, if they haven't killed him yet, or he hasn't succumbed to his wounds.
rows.quest:1515:completion:1: BI can feel the strength in me now, enough to hobble away... But my leg, I will have lost it for the rest of my life. My arm, too.
rows.quest:1598:obj:0: Retrieve the Powers of the Void for Drusilla La Salle.
rows.quest:1598:details:1: BI hope you're sure about becoming a warlock, because if you can't hold your own, you're likely to get pulled under.
rows.quest:1598:details:2: BI'm to teach you, but I need to make sure you're strong enough first.
rows.quest:1598:details:3: BThere was a novice studying at the Abbey who ran off to join the Defias Brotherhood. Why do I care? Well, he stole some important books.
rows.quest:1598:details:4: BOne of those happens to be a book I've wanted for myself, the Powers of the Void. Steal it for me, they have it hidden at their tent in the Vineyards.
rows.quest:1598:completion:0: Excellent... I was never able to gain access to this text, it was held in a protected wing of the library that would have looked suspicious for me to be loitering around.
rows.quest:1598:completion:1: BWell, you did a good job in getting this, and I'm convinced that you can probably handle your own imp, so there's no reason for me not to show you how to summon one.
rows.quest:1599:obj:0: Bring 3 Feather Charms to Alamar Grimm in Anvilmar.
rows.quest:1599:details:0: You must be the new warlock everyone's been whispering about. Must be someone's taken a liking to you if they've asked me to take time away from my research to start your training.
rows.quest:1599:details:1: BDon't worry, I won't hold it against you.
rows.quest:1599:details:2: BThe simplest of the summoning spells you will learn is that of the imp. Before I impart this to you, however, you must prove that you have the necessary magical and physical ability.
rows.quest:1599:details:3: BBring me three feather charms from the frostmane novices from the cave to the southwest.
rows.quest:1599:completion:0: Very good, very good! You've done well, ⟦24⟧. Perhaps the interest that is being shown in you is deserved, after all.
rows.quest:1599:completion:1: BThat'll be for the others to decide--assuming your imp doesn't overpower you and nip your career in the bud. For now, I'm satisfied that you'll probably survive your first few months as a warlock.
rows.quest:1599:completion:2: BA word about the imp, ⟦25⟧. As a gnome knows, don't let its size fool you, its magic can be very dangerous.
rows.quest:1685:obj:0: Report to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:1685:details:0: Isn't that how it always works? Was looking for you all day and couldn't find you, now when I'm not expecting it, you come and walk right up to me.
rows.quest:1685:details:1: BI've wasted enough time trying to find you, so I won't delay you any longer. Master Gakin's summoned you for additional training. Seems to me you should seek him out as soon as possible.
rows.quest:1685:details:2: BYou'll find him in the basement of the Slaughtered Lamb tavern. By the way, you might want to keep that particular location quiet. Don't want word spreading about it.
rows.quest:1685:completion:0: I'm glad someone was able to get a hold of you, ⟦26⟧. I was beginning to fear the worst. It would be a shame to lose you, after the time we've invested in you. We can talk later, though. Your training is the only important thing now.
rows.quest:1688:obj:0: Retrieve Surena's Choker for Gakin the Darkbinder in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:1688:details:0: I had a student named Surena Caledon. She stood where you stand now, eager to learn of warlock magic, and possessing no small bit of talent. More than that she was young and pleasing to the eye. Had I seen it then, the traitorous trollop!
rows.quest:1688:details:1: BThe thieving wench ran off with one of the Defias, Erlan Drudgemoor. While her loss is of little importance, I gifted her a bloodstone choker that I must have.
rows.quest:1688:details:2: BHer life means nothing to me now. You will find her at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch. Retrieve what is mine.
rows.quest:1688:completion:0: Surena was talented, but not enough so to gain mastery of warlock magic on her own. It's a shame to see talent wasted, but sometimes it is necessary.
rows.quest:1688:completion:1: BI hope my investment in you will bear different results.
rows.quest:1689:obj:0: Using the Bloodstone Choker, summon and subdue a voidwalker, then return the Bloodstone Choker to Gakin the Darkbinder in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:1689:details:0: By retrieving my choker and besting Surena, you've proven that you're at least as capable as she was.
rows.quest:1689:details:1: BWith that said, I can tell you're direly in need of training. You can manage the flows of magic, yes, but being a warlock is much more than that.
rows.quest:1689:details:2: BI will show you how to command a voidwalker, but before I can, you must call one forth at a summoning circle and subdue it using whatever weapons--physical and magical--you have at your disposal. Use the magic of this choker at the summoning circle below.
rows.quest:1689:completion:0: You did better than I expected, ⟦27⟧, but as well as I'd hoped. Now, you can learn to command your subjugated voidwalker, an ally you will find valuable in the trials that are sure to stand before you.
rows.quest:1689:completion:1: BI have nothing more to teach you at the present, but I am far from done with you, ⟦28⟧.
rows.quest:1715:obj:0: Report to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:1715:details:0: Hmph. Times past, all warlocks in Khaz Modan were trained under the auspices of the masters of Gnomeregan, but now that we've all been forced to relocate into this rat's hole in ⟦E10⟧, and Magni's decided to keep a careful watch on us, we're forced to send our novices to ⟦E9⟧ for training.
rows.quest:1715:details:1: BLuckily, Gakin's no slouch, so you'll still learn what you need to know, but it burns my blood!
rows.quest:1715:details:2: BAnyways, you'll find Gakin in the basement of the Slaughtered Lamb in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:1715:completion:0: Sent by Blackwrench, were you? Damn warlocks in ⟦E10⟧ need to get things sorted out. There's only so much room and so many teachers in ⟦E9⟧. With all the increased traffic, we're sure to attract attention sooner or later.
rows.quest:1716:obj:0: Speak with Takar the Seer in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:1716:details:0: A succubus is a devourer of souls, destroyer of hearts, and dominator of minds. It knows nothing but evil.
rows.quest:1716:details:1: BThis will be the creature you will learn to summon and control, but it cannot be brought into our world without a stimulus.
rows.quest:1716:details:2: BWith a symbol of love as bait, it will surely answer your call. Then you can defeat it, and make it your tool.
rows.quest:1716:details:3: BIt will be hard to find something of this nature, though. You should speak with Takar the Seer. You will find him in the ⟦E8⟧ of ⟦E11⟧ near Camp Taurajo.
rows.quest:1716:completion:0: Was your crossing difficult, ⟦29⟧? You have come a long way to speak with me. But fear not, I know why Gakin has sent you, and he was wise to, for I can help you in your search.
rows.quest:1717:obj:0: Report to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:1717:details:0: ⟦30⟧! Didn't expect to see you around these parts, but I was instructed to keep an eye out for you.
rows.quest:1717:details:1: BIt's past time you got some more training, so you should stop in to see Gakin the next time you're in ⟦E9⟧. He'll be waiting for you.
rows.quest:1717:completion:0: I'm glad someone was able to get a hold of you, ⟦31⟧. I was beginning to fear the worst. It would be a shame to lose you, after the time we've invested in you. We can talk later, though. Your training is the only important thing now.
rows.quest:1738:obj:0: Retrieve the Heartswood from ⟦E12⟧ and bring it to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:1738:details:0: In preparation for your coming, I used my sight to look over the world and through the mists of time. I have found what it is you seek.
rows.quest:1738:details:1: BIn the War of the Ancients, two lovers fell together in battle. Where they took their last breaths, a tree known as the heartswood grew, a symbol of their undying love.
rows.quest:1738:details:2: BThat should be enough to tempt a succubus. You will find it in the ruins of Ordil'Aran in the northwestern part of the forest of ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:1738:completion:0: Yes, I can tell this will do nicely, let me just work with it for a moment...
rows.quest:1738:completion:1: BTakar is a resourceful fellow to have around, isn't he? If only I could persuade him to move back to civilization.
rows.quest:1739:obj:0: Using the Heartswood Core, summon and subdue a succubus, then return the Heartswood Core to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Slaughtered Lamb.
rows.quest:1739:details:0: Using the heartswood core, you will be able to cast a spell at the summoning circle in the crypt below to open a portal for the succubus to pass through.
rows.quest:1739:details:1: BBe careful, ⟦32⟧, succubi have overrun even the strongest of minds.
rows.quest:1739:details:2: BOnce you have bested and returned it to the void, return to me and I will show you how to call and control it.
rows.quest:1739:completion:0: Well done, well done, ⟦33⟧. I see we've done right in deciding to train you. Your performance certainly does not disappoint.
rows.quest:1739:completion:1: BI've no qualms in showing you the way to control your newly bound succubus. Observe carefully.
rows.quest:1740:obj:0: Find 3 Soran'ruk Fragments and 1 Large Soran'ruk Fragment and return them to Doan Karhan in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:1740:details:0: When demons of the Legion fall out of favor, their spirits are imprisoned within orbs and distributed to their mages and warlocks.
rows.quest:1740:details:1: BMany were carried by their servants in ⟦E13⟧. Even fragmented, they still possess the powers of the demons trapped inside.
rows.quest:1740:details:2: BThe orb of Soran'ruk was broken into two pieces, one was further broken to be used by the acolytes of the Twilight's ⟦E14⟧ in Blackfathom Deeps. The other, larger piece, was possessed by a wizard in Shadowfang Keep. Find them and I can reform it.
rows.quest:1740:completion:0: Yes... The orb was not greatly fragmented, and almost all of the pieces are here. It is a simple thing to recreate them, to make Soran'ruk whole again.
rows.quest:1740:completion:1: BI have dedicated my life to the study of the ⟦E15⟧'s orbs and their recreation. You have done me a favor collecting these pieces to study, and I will give you them back - fully reconstructed - in a form of your choosing.
rows.quest:1758:details:0: It will take more than a simple summoning circle to bring forth a felhunter for you to challenge.
rows.quest:1758:details:1: BMy three acolytes and I will assist in creating the magic circles. You require a copy of the Tome of the Cabal, which has been lost to us for some time. It was written by the first group of warlocks to summon a felhunter unaided.
rows.quest:1758:details:2: BPerhaps Krom Stoutarm can help you with this. An itinerant warlock these days, he spends his days hoarding ancient texts and skulking about the library in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:1758:completion:0: Tome of Cabal? Hmm...sounds familiar. I have never seen it here before, though--and believe me, I remember every book I read.
rows.quest:1758:completion:2: BI have seen reference to it in library cataloging books.
rows.quest:1795:obj:0: Using the Tome of the Cabal, summon and subdue a felhunter, then return the Tome of the Cabal to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
rows.quest:1795:details:0: If you are sufficiently prepared, then we should begin. Let me explain the process to you.
rows.quest:1795:details:1: BI will begin by creating the basic summoning circle. When that is finished, my acolytes will use the rods of channeling to create the greater circle.
rows.quest:1795:details:2: BOnce that is done, read the incantation from the Tome of the Cabal, and the felhunter will be pulled forth. Be careful, ⟦34⟧. A felhunter is a powerful foe, and I'd like to see you keep your head on your shoulders.
rows.quest:1795:completion:0: I must say I'm impressed, ⟦35⟧. When I faced down my felhunter, I barely escaped with my life. I sense that you have the potential to become one of the most powerful warlocks of this era.
rows.quest:1796:obj:0: Bring Robes of the Arcana to Menara Voidrender in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:1796:details:0: The first item I will aid you in creating is a robe. You will gather the items for me, and we will put them together. Afterwards, assuming you succeed, you will have the first of many items that will make you more powerful and aid you in your struggles.
rows.quest:1796:details:1: BTo start, you must have crafted Robes of Arcana. A tailor can make this for you, or perhaps you can purchase one from someone else--I'd be most impressed if you could make it yourself--but regardless, bring me the robes, and we shall go from there.
rows.quest:1796:completion:1: BAll magical items must begin with an item of high quality. The more effort and skill put into an item, the greater the magics it can hold. Rare and more expensive components hold the magic better. You will not regret having the robes fashioned into the ones we will make for you later on.
rows.quest:1798:obj:0: Speak with Strahad Farsan in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:1798:details:0: It is time you learned the felhunter summoning, ⟦37⟧. I do not have the reagents and items necessary to teach you here, so you will have to seek out another, Strahad Farsan, another of our inner circle.
rows.quest:1798:details:1: BHe makes his residence in the goblin port of Ratchet. I will send word ahead of you to inform him of your coming.
rows.quest:1798:completion:0: ⟦38⟧? Ah, of course. Our latest prodigy. The real thing can not live up to the legend, I am afraid.
rows.quest:1798:completion:1: BNo matter, you have come here to learn, not to hear me make jokes to myself.
rows.quest:1799:obj:0: Speak to Menara's acolytes inside the tower above Ratchet and choose one of their paths to follow.
rows.quest:1799:obj:1: BAfterwards, bring an Infernal Orb to Tabetha in ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:1799:details:1: BThe first thing you must do is speak to my acolytes inside. Choose one of their paths to follow--they will explain more.
rows.quest:1799:details:2: BSecond, you must travel to ⟦E17⟧ and find an Infernal Orb from one of the warlocks of Mannoroc Coven. It is that orb that you will cleanse with the help of a mage named Tabetha deep in southern ⟦E16⟧. She will aid you because of our history together.
rows.quest:1799:details:3: BAgain, do not come back until you have done both things I've asked.
rows.quest:1799:completion:0: Oh, so Menara sent you. Fair enough... I suppose you may stay as my guest for the time being. But you must be on some pressing business - perhaps you're here seeking lost power? Maybe I'm mistaken. Maybe corruption isn't too far away from you after all.
rows.quest:1801:obj:0: Speak with Jorah Annison in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1801:details:0: It will take more than a simple summoning circle to bring forth a felhunter for you to challenge.
rows.quest:1801:details:1: BMy three acolytes and I will assist in creating the magic circles. You require a copy of the Tome of the Cabal, which has been lost to us for some time. It was written by the first group of warlocks to summon a felhunter unaided.
rows.quest:1801:details:2: BPerhaps Jorah Annison can help you with this. He's employed as a cartographer in the ⟦E1⟧ these days, but still knows more of ancient texts than any I know.
rows.quest:1801:completion:0: Map making! Pictures, estimations of reality. I have no use for such things.
rows.quest:1801:completion:1: BIn books, narrative, description! That is where truth lies. I would trade all the maps in this store for one book on the rise of necromancy, or a tale of the Dark Lady's triumph.
rows.quest:1802:obj:0: Retrieve the Moldy Tome and Tattered Manuscript for Krom Stoutarm in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:1802:details:0: It was lost, but there's some idea as to where it might be found.
rows.quest:1802:details:1: BThere was only one copy ever made and it was vandalized at some point, a large portion of it ripped from the binding. Rumor has it that it somehow passed into the hands of the centaur of ⟦E18⟧.
rows.quest:1802:details:2: BThe rest was lost off the coast west of ⟦E19⟧, where it was to be transported to Menethil ⟦E20⟧ by boat. It never arrived.
rows.quest:1802:details:3: BIn exchange for this knowledge, all I ask is that if you find it, bring it to me to see.
rows.quest:1802:completion:0: Fantastic! Now I may join the ranks of the few that have spied its contents.
rows.quest:1802:completion:1: BI can't wait to further peruse this text. This is a great day, ⟦39⟧! If you will just allow me to glance at it before you leave. I'm sure that Strahad will be willing to send me a copy.
rows.quest:1803:obj:0: Retrieve the Moldy Tome and Tattered Manuscript for Jorah Annison in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1803:details:0: Ah! I see that you are a warlock of similar tastes to mine. Indeed, acquiring the Tome of the Cabal is a worthy aspiration. Did you know that it was once held within the walls of Lordaeron? It was vandalized though, almost half its pages removed. Who would commit such a heinous act?
rows.quest:1803:details:1: BThat half is lost, though rumor says that it fell into the hands of the centaur of the ⟦E18⟧.
rows.quest:1803:details:2: BThe rest of the text was to be transferred to ⟦E10⟧, but was lost in transit on the coast west of ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:1803:completion:0: Well well well! What do we have here?
rows.quest:1803:completion:1: BThis is impressive, ⟦40⟧. I wouldn't have thought it possible, but here it is in my very hands, the complete Tome of the Cabal.
rows.quest:1803:completion:2: BAllow me to leaf through its pages for just a moment before you are off again.
rows.quest:1804:obj:0: Bring the Reconstructed Tome and 3 Rods of Channeling to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
rows.quest:1804:details:0: Well, ah, it's hard to let it go. But you found it, and you have more important things to do with it, of course. Just, please, be sure to mention to Strahad that I wanted a copy.
rows.quest:1804:details:1: BWhile you were out, he sent a message for you. He wanted me to tell you that for his acolytes to assist with the summoning, you'll have to acquire three rods of channeling.
rows.quest:1804:details:2: BHe might not know where to find them, but I do! They were last used by the orcs of the Dragonmaw clan in the ⟦E3⟧. I'd check their spellcasters!
rows.quest:1804:completion:0: Well done! The Tome of the Cabal and three pristine--slightly scratched, I suppose--rods of channeling.
rows.quest:1804:completion:1: BThis will be interesting. It's been some time since a young warlock took on a felhunter to make his own.
